WoW: Forever

Retribution Paladin

Two-handed melee with Holy magic layered on top. Holy StrikeHoly StrikeLevel 6 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 8CastInstantCost5 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown10 sec cooldownAn instant strike that causes 25% weapon damage plus an additional 11 to 14 as Holy damage. at level 6 turns it from auto-attack-and-wait into something you actually play, twenty levels earlier than Classic gave a Paladin a button.

WoW: Forever · Melee DPS · Updated November 13, 2026 · Client build 1.60.1.70938 · Null Ossuary

A guide to the live game, levels 1 to 60. Talents open at 10. The one-point gold medal talents sit at 11, 21 and 31 points, with a new one at 16 points, which for Retribution is Sacred ArbiterSacred ArbiterTalentCastInstantIncreases the damage of your Holy Strike ability by 20% and causes it to refresh all Judgement effects on the target. at level 25. RepentanceRepentanceTalentCastInstantCost60 ManaRange20 yd rangeCooldown60 sec cooldownDuration6 secPuts the enemy target in a state of meditation, incapacitating them for up to 6 sec. Any damage caused will awaken the target. Only works against Humanoids. sits at 21 points and Unsealed WrathUnsealed WrathTalentCastInstantYour melee attacks store a copy of your active Seal for 15 sec, stacking up to 3 times. Landing an attack with a different Seal consumes all stacks, giving the stored Seal its normal chance to activate once per stack. at 31. Dual Specialization is bought from the class trainer at 40, for 50 gold by Wowhead's report.

Mechanics are Blizzard's where Blizzard has spoken: the October 15 Paladin deep dive, the November 2 development notes and the hotfixes through November 11. Where it says nothing, the current client is the source, build 1.60.1.70938. A hover tooltip can lag a hotfix: where a tooltip and the prose differ, the prose is right.

The talent builds are Wowhead's and Icy Veins', published November 4 and replayed here against the current tree. Wowhead says of its own pages that the class changed heavily between the beta and launch and that beta findings are limited. Notes marked as WoWSims' are a model of a level-60 boss fight. No raid opens until December 9, 2026, so no log ranks either published build.

Two kinds of caveat run through these pages and they do not mean the same thing. Something marked as ours is our own reasoning, not a source's. A client or guide-site reading is a number Blizzard has not published.

What Retribution is for

Layering Holy damage onto a two-handed swing, with a real button to press from level 6. Seal of CommandSeal of CommandLevel 20 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantCost65 ManaDuration30 secGives the Paladin a chance to deal additional Holy damage equal to 70% of normal weapon damage. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Lasts 30 sec. Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy, instantly causing 70.9 Holy damage, 138 to 146 if the target is stunned or incapacitated. at 20 procs Holy damage scaled off the swing, and a stun amplifies its Judgement.

Blizzard's framing for the spec is three things: new ways to sustain Judgements, weapon attacks blended with Holy damage, and a more approachable form of Seal Twisting. Sustaining Judgements starts in row 2 with Sanctified JudgementSanctified JudgementTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstantGives your Judgement ability a 100% chance to return 60% of the Mana cost of the judged seal.. The capstone in the twisting slot, Unsealed WrathUnsealed WrathTalentCastInstantYour melee attacks store a copy of your active Seal for 15 sec, stacking up to 3 times. Landing an attack with a different Seal consumes all stacks, giving the stored Seal its normal chance to activate once per stack., arrives at 31 points, level 40.

It is the solo levelling spec of the three. Wowhead's levelling page calls it one of the smoother classes to level: little downtime, plate and self-healing, and burst from JudgementJudgementLevel 4 · Spell · HolyCastInstantCost6% of base ManaRange10 yd rangeCooldown10 sec cooldownUnleash the energy of a Seal spell upon an enemy. Does not consume the Seal. Refer to individual Seals for Judgement effect. and Holy StrikeHoly StrikeLevel 6 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 8CastInstantCost5 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown10 sec cooldownAn instant strike that causes 25% weapon damage plus an additional 11 to 14 as Holy damage. that is back up for each new enemy. It lists the costs too: no ranged pull, heavy dependence on your weapon, and real trouble once out of mana. Icy Veins lists the same strengths and adds no answer to casters and no slow.

You have no area damage until ConsecrationConsecrationLevel 20 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantCost135 ManaCooldown8 sec cooldownDuration8 secConsecrates the land beneath the Paladin, doing 16 Holy damage over 8 sec to enemies who enter the area. The first 4 enemies who enter the area will take an additional 32 damage over 8 sec. at 20. Blizzard trains it to every Paladin now instead of selling it as a Holy talent, and it only damages four enemies properly. Pull one target at a time.

Blizzard states the class has no interrupt and no way to slow an enemy's movement, and that Holy talents widen its range without matching other mana users. Your own speed comes from one talent, Pursuit of JusticePursuit of JusticeTalent · Rank 2 of 2CastInstantIncreases movement speed and mounted movement speed by 15%. This does not stack with other movement speed increasing effects..

Treat mana as an extension of your health bar. Topping up with Holy LightHoly LightLevel 1 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 9Cast2.5 sec castCost35 ManaRange40 yd rangeHeals a friendly target for 42 to 50. and killing the next thing at low mana usually beats sitting down to drink.

Multi-target: none until 20. Then ConsecrationConsecrationLevel 20 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantCost135 ManaCooldown8 sec cooldownDuration8 secConsecrates the land beneath the Paladin, doing 16 Holy damage over 8 sec to enemies who enter the area. The first 4 enemies who enter the area will take an additional 32 damage over 8 sec., and it is expensive: 135 Mana at rank 1, on an 8-second cooldown. Blizzard limits what it can do on purpose: moderate damage to the first 4 enemies that walk into it, very low damage to everything after that, so Paladin threat stays level with a Warrior's Thunderclap. The thin damage on the fifth target is the design, and Blizzard says the limit keeps Forever out of expansion-era AoE pulling. The client agrees. Its rank 1 does 16 Holy damage over 8 seconds to anything in the area, with an extra 32 over 8 seconds for the first four.

It has a 2-second cast, and Wowhead says the spec generally avoids hard casts because they reset the swing timer.

There is no damage cooldown. Wowhead notes Forever has nothing like Avenging Wrath, so there is no burst window to plan around.

Stat priority

Your weapon first. Both sites put the weapon above every stat. After that:

  • Wowhead, October 31: Weapon Skill, weapon DPS and speed, Hit to 9%, Expertise to 6.5%, Spell Damage, Intellect, Strength and Attack Power, Agility and critical strike, Stamina.

They disagree twice. Wowhead gives 9% Hit as the safe target against a raid boss until someone confirms it at 60, and Icy Veins gives 8%. Wowhead ranks Spell Damage and Intellect above Strength for every build, and Icy Veins ranks Strength above Spell Power for the Unsealed WrathUnsealed WrathTalentCastInstantYour melee attacks store a copy of your active Seal for 15 sec, stacking up to 3 times. Landing an attack with a different Seal consumes all stacks, giving the stored Seal its normal chance to activate once per stack. build. Both lists were written from beta data, and both say level-60 gear may change them.

Hit is one stat in Forever. Expertise is new and removes dodges, and both sites put its ceiling for a boss at 6.5%.

While levelling, Hit and Expertise are rare on gear, so weapon damage decides most upgrades. Icy Veins says Spell Power is worth wearing leather or cloth for, because nearly everything except your white swing scales with it.

Intellect matters much more from 26 points in the tree, at level 35, where Champion of the LightChampion of the LightTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantIncreases your spell damage by up to 60% of your Intellect, and reduces the cast time of your Hammer of Wrath by 1.0 sec. starts converting it into spell damage. Blizzard places the talent in row 6 of this tree.

It converts up to 60% of your Intellect at 5 points, 12% a rank, by Blizzard's November 2 notes. Icy Veins' stat page agrees. ClassicWoW.gg still prints 20, 40 and 60% over 3 ranks, Wowhead's stat page prints 60% "at 3/3", and Icy Veins' class overview says it raises healing too. Blizzard confines the effect to damage.

Spell Power and Intellect scale both builds through Champion of the LightChampion of the LightTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantIncreases your spell damage by up to 60% of your Intellect, and reduces the cast time of your Hammer of Wrath by 1.0 sec., by Wowhead's account more than Strength does. Icy Veins is less sure for the capstone build, as the stat lists above show.

Blizzard frames the choice as deliberate: it positioned Holy ShockHoly ShockLevel 30 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost160 ManaRange20 yd range, 40 yd on alliesCooldown10 sec cooldownBlasts the target with Holy energy, causing 129 to 139 Holy damage to an enemy, or 110 to 118 healing to an ally. as the alternative so that opting out of the capstone is a real build. Its closing line is that Retribution stays a strong damage dealer with steadier damage and more group utility, naming Sacred ArbiterSacred ArbiterTalentCastInstantIncreases the damage of your Holy Strike ability by 20% and causes it to refresh all Judgement effects on the target. and its upkeep of other Paladins' Judgements as the example.
